name: C3D Sports1M then UCF101 finetuned initialization
depth_ir: four channels; RGB weights scaled .75 and IR initialized from RGB mean; same synchronized crop
input: 16 frames resized from existing 128x128 cache to112x112, normalized by original RGB mean values; IR uses mean
validation: 466 public clips for evaluation and model selection only
candidate_fusion: C3D and previously trained X3D-M fixed C3D weights 0.25,0.5,0.75, only if <=100M
final_comparison: use full raw-image inference metrics; keep previous best unless strictly improved
note: pretrained from Sports1M then UCF101; no extra CUHK training; training/validation do not use RGB from contest data
